kiel-north-ostsee-kanal-rendsburg-loop.story: Ships, bridges and low-stress sweepers away from the city. The best part sits around Rendsburg high bridge, Kiel Canal towpath view, Gettorf return road, while the most useful town stop keeps the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel or food hunt. Check the OSM map, Google preview and GPX checkpoint order before departure; they use the same waypoint sequence. Ride it with legal pull-offs, patience through villages and enough daylight to stop without rushing.

places-la-risca-iii-letreros-de-los-mart.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-la-risca-iii-letreros-de-los-mart.story: From Moratalla it runs 162 km to Moratalla; allow about 2 h 48 of riding. On the way it passes Cavidad V, Arroyo de la fuente de las Zorras, Letreros de los mártires and back through Arroyo de la fuente de las Zorras. The highest point is about 1,400 m. The line favours views over speed.
